verdict.rationale: Docusign CLM documents a drag-and-drop editor for designing contract processes and dynamic templates for generating contracts. It also claims AI that flags non-compliant clauses and drafts approved language. AI-Assisted Review suggests redlines against playbooks and works inside MS Word, and real-time commenting is listed for collaboration. Together these cover drafting and redlining within a controlled workflow. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of counterparty negotiation (version tracking, redline exchange with the other side), in-depth workflow documentation beyond marketing claims, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
